content: A drop of pure ink from a righteous pen can make a million minds contemplate eternity.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: Galam-e ahl-e del — Classical Persian Calligraphic Lore
explanation: Swords conquer land only until the general dies and the empire is overrun. But an honest word written with truth, compassion, and divine love echoes across thousand-year horizons, melting swords into ploughshares and inspiring generations to awaken.
practicalInsight: Write an honest, encouraging, or truthful message to someone today. Never underestimate the power of written ink.
reflectionPrompt: How are you using the power of your words and writing to bring light to the world?
